subquery: What obligations does the EU AI Act impose on small SaaS vendors?

summary.value: The EU AI Act classifies AI systems by risk level. Small SaaS vendors providing general-purpose AI tools are generally subject to transparency obligations under Article 52. High-risk AI system providers (e.g. HR, credit scoring, biometrics) face heavier obligations including conformity assessments and technical documentation under Articles 9-17.

risk_classification.value: The Act defines four risk tiers: unacceptable risk (prohibited), high-risk (Articles 9-17 obligations), limited risk (Article 52 transparency), and minimal risk (no obligations). Most general-purpose SaaS tools fall in limited or minimal risk categories.

proposed_extensions.description: SME exemptions or sandboxes under the EU AI Act
proposed_extensions.rationale: Multiple sources mention regulatory sandboxes as a relief mechanism for SMEs
